She smiles and begins a series of expressive, dance-like gestures with her hands and arms, her mouth open in a joyful expression. (2) The woman continues her rhythmic movements, extending her arms wide and spinning slightly as snow falls around her. A second person, dressed in dark clothing, is crouched low behind her, rhythmically scooping and throwing large handfuls of snow into the air to create a dramatic flurry effect that mimics the scenery of the song. The background features modern buildings and a dull, overcast grey sky typical of a winter day. (3) Laughing and beaming at the camera, the woman opens her arms to the sky as the artificial snow shower continues to fall over her. She maintains high energy and a playful demeanor throughout the sequence. At the very end, she leans forward towards the lens, bringing her face into a close-up while maintaining a wide, cheerful grin before the shot ends.
